value.rationale: The fixed-seed negative-bias perturbation turns an indefinitely persistent positive-branch orbit at the B=0 border into a trajectory with finite reset latency. Exact bias thresholds and a sharp three-regime spectral law describe a mathematically natural switching first-passage invariant. The defective stable root produces a distinct logarithm-of-logarithm delay, a structural transition invisible to stability classifications or simple eigenvalue magnitudes; this is not merely code-based or a generic parameter renaming.
